extracted.name: Easy vegan gravy
extracted.description: Pair this easy vegan gravy with nut roast and lentil-based dishes. It adds a salty, umami punch to roasted roots, steamed greens and Sunday roasts
ingredient_lines: 1 tsp cashew butter or another nut butter (optional)
instruction_lines: Heat the miso paste in a saucepan with 800ml water. Whisk to dissolve, then bring to a simmer. Add a little more water if needed.

Mix the cornflour with 2 tsp water until smooth, then stir a little of the mixture into the miso. Let it bubble and thicken, stirring occasionally. If the gravy isn't thick enough, add an extra splash of the cornflour mixture.
For extra richness, add the nut butter (if using) to the mixture and stir well. Season to taste, then serve.
